pit_rules.signal_available_from: audit report rcept_dt (from rcept_no[:8] for t1; rcept_dt for t3). Signal at month-end sig_date t only if rcept_dt <= t. Holding month t+1 starts after t => C5 satisfied.
pit_rules.financial_lag: audit reports filed ~Mar-Apr of FY+1 (C4). carry latest FY audit whose rcept_dt <= sig_date.
pit_rules.universe_pit: membership from RAWDATA K200/KQ150 at each month-end (time-varying).
pit_rules.survivorship_caveat: audit data pulled for CURRENT ~348 constituents (not PIT-delisted firms). Delisted-after-nonclean firms ABSENT => exclusion effect UNDERESTIMATED (conservative direction). Documented, not fully fixable without delisted-firm audit history.

A_signal_form.construct: monthly EW long portfolio of FLAGGED names; forward 1M return.
A_signal_form.basis_authoritative: cap-w benchmark (BM_Ret) active return, PORT_t NW lag-3 via build_benchmark_compare.
A_signal_form.size_tier: MEGA(cap rank 1-10) / MID(11-30) / small(31+) decomposition of flagged group + tier-conditional flagged-vs-unflagged spread.
A_signal_form.interpretation: flagged group NEGATIVE active with |t|>=2 => flag has bad-firm content.

B_exclusion_form_primary.construct: base = EW deploy universe (each month EW over eligible liq-pass members); exclusion = same minus flagged names, reweighted EW.
B_exclusion_form_primary.test: canonical paired NW-t on monthly (exclusion_ret - base_ret) difference series + each vs BM active PORT_t.
B_exclusion_form_primary.also: canonical_screen_bt with clean-preference score (score = -flag_severity) top-25 vs score-constant top-25 to show exclusion rarely touches deploy top-25.
B_exclusion_form_primary.interpretation: positive paired NW-t (exclusion helps) with cap-w significance = deployable exclusion value.

verdict_thresholds.primary_pass: exclusion paired NW-t >= 2.0 AND cap-w significant (flagged active PORT_t <= -2.0 authoritative)
verdict_thresholds.graduation_note: canonical is screening (metric_type canonical_screen). Capital graduation authority = forge + essence_score (PORT_t 2.95 / oos_retention 0.7 / calmar 0.64). This round is signal/screen only.
verdict_thresholds.n_trials: 4 primary surfaces (S1-S4) in parallel = family accounting; S5 robustness-only. selection_type=chain (hypothesis-driven, not sweep) => DSR advisory.
